- Amount: ₦250,000
- Recipient: Access Bank, account 0234567891
- Status: Credited to the recipient account
- Credited: 21 November 2026
- Bank session ID: 000014261121140211000088

So the ₦250,000 for invoice INV-88 has already been paid to your account — no resend is needed. If you still don't see it in your Access Bank account after checking again, please reach out with your bank statement showing it's missing, and we'll investigate further with the session ID above.

Apologies for the confusion on our side.
